name: Iterative Convolution and Thresholding for Noise Removal
aliases: Noise Removal via Iterative Convolution and Thresholding
definition: Removes scattered noise voxels from the grid by iteratively applying a convolution with a filled circle kernel and zeroing out voxels below a threshold.
summary: Iterative Convolution and Thresholding removes scattered noise voxels by repeatedly convolving with a filled circle kernel and zeroing low-intensity values, acting as a binary cleaner distinct from gradient-preserving or averaging filters.
